title: The Guest List
author: Lucy Foley
summary: A glossy wedding is held on a windswept Irish island, with a storm rolling in and tensions among the guests. By the end of the night, someone is dead and the story shifts between several perspectives.
readIf: you like a juicy, closed-setting mystery with lots of secrets and a creeping sense of dread.
skipIf: you want a single clear protagonist, since the book jumps between many narrators and time frames.

pairings.reason: The author's earlier book with a nearly identical formula, set in a snowed-in Scottish lodge.
The original and sharper model of a group stuck in an isolated place with a killer.
A lighter, young-adult version with a closed group of suspects and secrets coming out.
